items.title: Component and Process Analysis of Cognitive Therapy
items.rights_note: Official ACBS publication record and abstract for the early comprehensive-distancing trial; not the later six-process ACT model.

items.title: About Acceptance and Commitment Therapy
items.rights_note: Professional association description; evidence of current framing and continuation, not independent efficacy evidence.

items.title: The effect of acceptance and commitment therapy on the psychological flexibility and inflexibility of undergraduate students
items.rights_note: Open process-focused meta-analysis limited to undergraduates; does not establish a universal mechanism.

items.title: Effect of acceptance and commitment therapy for depressive disorders: a meta-analysis
items.rights_note: Open disorder-specific synthesis; heterogeneity and control conditions bound conclusions.

items.title: The Effects of Internet-Based Acceptance and Commitment Therapy on Process Measures
items.rights_note: Open synthesis of internet ACT process measures; modality-specific and not interchangeable with therapist-delivered ACT.

items.title: Efficacy of Internet-Based Acceptance and Commitment Therapy for Depressive Symptoms, Anxiety, Stress, Psychological Distress, and Quality of Life
items.rights_note: Open outcome synthesis restricted to internet-delivered ACT; active- and passive-control results must remain separate.
